blocks.body:
# FloodGuard Controlled Three-Model Experiment - Gate Evidence Report

The experiment remains fail-closed. The two Sentinel-1 product identities and SAFE checksums are verified, but a signed acquisition-authority receipt, qualified binary reference raster, dual-signed reviewer qualification, immutable holdout evidence, signed mask-derived reference cells, and a predeclared promotion policy are absent. Completed model evidence is deliberately deferred until execution is authorized; it is not a circular readiness prerequisite. No model-comparison metrics are reported as real evidence.

## Technical summary

The governed Sentinel-1 pre/post pair re-hashes exactly to the acquisition registry. No externally signed product-specific authority decision and matching internal integrity receipt authorize the editable acquisition manifest. The available MBRSC ZIP is a provider vector candidate, not the required qualified single-band binary reference raster; derivative permissions and scientific qualification remain unresolved. Reviewer qualification, frozen holdout, mask-derived reference cells, and the signed promotion policy are missing. The final comparison therefore cannot start, and decision-layer use, FPPS use, and warning claims remain prohibited.

## Key findings

Three machine-verifiable Sentinel-1 source controls pass. Six pre-execution control groups remain blocked: acquisition authority, qualified reference raster, reviewer qualification, immutable spatial holdout, signed reference cells, and predeclared promotion policy. Completed three-model evidence is deferred until those gates authorize execution. A metric value of zero would falsely imply measured performance, so IoU, Dice/F1, precision, recall, area error, Brier score, and calibration are intentionally absent rather than zero-filled.

## Scope, data, and metric definitions

Scope is the governed Mae Sai event package. A real comparison requires a deterministic SAR baseline, the weak-label logistic model, and an isolated GeoAI U-Net/FPN candidate evaluated only on the same untouched `final_holdout` cells against one qualified binary reference mask. The immutable spatial release has disjoint `train`, `calibration`, and `final_holdout` polygons; thresholds are frozen from calibration evidence before the final holdout is opened. IoU is TP/(TP+FP+FN); Dice/F1 is 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); precision is TP/(TP+FP); recall is TP/(TP+FN). Area error is predicted flood area minus reference flood area and is also reported as a finite ratio of reference area. Brier score is the mean squared difference between class-1 probability and the binary reference. Calibration is reported with fixed probability-bin predicted-versus-observed rates plus expected calibration error. Required error strata are permanent water, wet soil/agriculture, radar shadow, layover/double-bounce, steep terrain, urban surface, speckle, narrow channels, flood-boundary disagreement, temporal land-cover change, missing/noisy inputs, reference-label uncertainty, and geometry mismatch.

## Methodology

The audit checks immutable product IDs, source identity, acquisition timestamps, assumptions, SHA-256 digests, explicit use permissions and timing, reference authority, and reviewer roles and calibration. Spatial membership is re-derived from descriptor-bound geometry and a signed projected-metre equal-area grid contract; physical cell area comes from the affine determinant, and cell IDs, indices, centers, and all three partition hashes must match exactly. Each signed model-run receipt binds one strict lane-specific contract, the same acquisition and reference lineage, a calibration-only threshold, a portable runtime profile, and the untouched final-holdout hash. The comparison emits signed report-only metrics, reliability bins and SVG, error-stratum counts, runtime evidence, and a separately reviewed promotion recommendation. Any missing, expired, malformed, or substituted required control blocks execution and promotion.

## Limitations and robustness

The MBRSC provider ZIP contains vector geometry and cannot satisfy the executable single-band binary-raster contract without a separately identified, checksummed, licensed, reviewed, and qualified derived artifact. UNOSAT product 3991 is preliminary and not field validated; its public artifact is supplementary context, not an accepted project reference mask. The local manual reference package has no accepted authority or calibrated independent review. These are evidence gaps, not model-performance results.

## Next steps

1. Obtain product-specific permissions for local analysis, ML/label use, validation, derived reporting, display, and redistribution or reference-only handling; qualify the exact binary reference-raster bytes and issue the acquisition-authority receipt.
2. Complete the blind reviewer-calibration release with two independent reviewers and a distinct adjudicator; issue the dual-signed qualification, then freeze non-overlapping train/calibration/final-holdout polygons and mask-derived membership receipts.
3. Sign the promotion policy and obtain a ready pre-execution receipt. Only then select thresholds from calibration-only evidence, run the three identical-holdout model lanes, publish signed metrics and error analysis, and issue a separate report-only promotion recommendation.

## Further questions

Which agency or qualified external authority can accept the reference-mask specification? Who will serve as two independent reviewers and adjudicator? What retention and attribution terms govern the resulting labels?

accessIssues.message: An externally signed product-specific authority decision plus a matching internal integrity receipt must bind the exact product IDs, rights, evidence bytes, and artifact hashes.
A qualified reference authority and an exact accepted single-band binary reference raster are required; the provider vector candidate is not sufficient.
Two independent reviewers, an adjudicator, blinded calibration evidence, and a passing receipt are required.
Immutable spatial holdout polygons, an exact signed equal-area grid contract, affine-derived cell membership, and checksums are required.
A reference-authority HMAC-signed internal integrity receipt must bind qualified reference-cell labels and documented error strata to the accepted mask and holdout.
A signed predeclared policy must freeze calibration, metric, and promotion criteria before execution.
